title: Report: Joey Bosa has "more likely than not" played his final NFL snap

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Report: Joey Bosa has "more likely than not" played his final NFL snap
sources.description: 49ers defensive end Nick Bosa cast doubt on his older brother Joey playing in the NFL in 2026 in May when he said that his brother is not "thinking too much about football" while working on his golf game.
